title: Native Sync Script Settings
description: Configuration file for native-sync.ps1 script (pure PowerShell file synchronization)

schedule.runMonth: Array of month names (e.g. 'January', 'June', 'December') to run sync. Empty array = every month.
schedule.runWeekday: Array of weekday names (e.g. 'Monday', 'Friday') to run sync. Empty array = every day.
schedule.runTime: Array of UTC times in HH:mm format when sync should run.
schedule.minIntervalMinutes: Minimum minutes between sync runs to prevent duplicate executions.

_comments.syncMode: Synchronization mode: 'Mirror' (make right identical to left), 'Update' (copy new/updated to right only), 'TwoWay' (propagate changes both ways)
_comments.compareMethod: File comparison method: 'TimeAndSize' (compare by modification time and file size)
_comments.deletionPolicy: How to handle deleted files: 'RecycleBin' (move to recycle bin), 'Permanent' (delete permanently), 'Versioning' (move to versioning folder)
_comments.versioningFolder: Path for versioning folder when deletionPolicy is 'Versioning'. Leave empty if not using versioning.
_comments.folderPairs: Array of folder pairs to synchronize. Each pair has 'left' (source) and 'right' (destination) paths.

filters.include: Array of patterns to include. Use '*' to include all files.
filters.exclude: Array of patterns to exclude. Supports wildcards and path patterns.

options.dryRun: Simulate sync without making changes (can also use -DryRun parameter)

_comments.nasRootShare: UNC path to NAS root share for authentication. Only used for connecting to the share.
_comments.credentialEnvVar: Name of Machine-level environment variable containing Base64-encoded 'username:password' for NAS authentication
